title: Geometry
summary: Angles in triangles and polygons, parallel lines, congruent triangles and proof, enlargement and similar triangles.

cards.title: Angles and triangles
cards.rule: Triangle angles add to 180°. Angles on a straight line add to 180°, around a point 360°.
lines: Two angles are 50° and 60°: the third is **70°**
Exterior angle = sum of the two opposite interior angles
cards.note: An isosceles triangle has two equal sides and two equal base angles.

cards.title: Parallel lines
cards.rule: Corresponding angles are equal (F), alternate angles are equal (Z), co-interior angles add to 180° (C).
lines: If one angle is 65°, its co-interior angle is **115°**
cards.tip: these rules only work when the lines are parallel.

cards.title: Quadrilaterals and polygons
cards.rule: Interior angle sum of an \(n\)-sided polygon: \((n - 2) \times 180^\circ\).
lines: Hexagon: \(4 \times 180^\circ = 720^\circ\); each angle of a regular hexagon is 120°

cards.title: Congruent triangles
cards.rule: Congruent means exactly the same shape and size (≅). Tests: SSS, SAS, AAS, RHS.
lines: SAS: two sides and the angle between them
RHS: right angle, hypotenuse and one side
cards.tip: AAA is not a congruence test: same angles can be different sizes.

cards.title: Using congruence in proof
cards.rule: List the equal parts with a reason for each, name the test, then conclude.
lines: AB = CD and BC = DA (opposite sides of a parallelogram)

cards.title: Enlargement and similar figures
cards.rule: Scale factor \(= \dfrac{\text{image length}}{\text{original length}}\). Angles stay the same.
lines: A 4 cm side enlarged by a scale factor of 2.5 becomes **10 cm**
cards.note: Similar figures: same shape, sides in the same ratio.

cards.title: Similar triangles
cards.rule: Tests: AAA, SSS (ratio), SAS (ratio), RHS (ratio). Match the sides in order.

cards.title: Proving and applying similar triangles
cards.rule: Show the triangles are similar, then use the scale factor.
lines: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow. A tree's shadow is 12 m at the same time.
cards.tip: write the vertices in matching order: △ABC ||| △DEF.
